name: self-improving-refunds
title: Self-improving refund desk (invariants fixed, playbook learned)

origin.source: Created in this repository as a test of the bitter-lesson objection to hand-built agent structure: a refund desk whose business rules are guards on a frozen outer machine, and whose way of working is a JSON playbook machine the agent rewrites between batches through gated proposals (validate, vocabulary, lower, lint, explore, replay, promote), benchmarked against a raw tool-calling loop.

comparison.purpose: The agent rewrites its own way of working as a JSON machine, but the business rules are guards the rewrite cannot touch, plus a sentinel state proven unreachable for any proposal sequence. The benchmark shows the raw tool loop breaking the rules, the fixed desk never breaking them whatever decides, and the learned playbook getting more accurate and cheaper than the prompt-only one.
